description:
Several Python generators feed the current site:
- scripts/generate_query_docs.py, run from the conf.py config-inited hook into docs/benchmarks/queries/
- scripts/generate_compat_docs.py
- scripts/generate_landing_quickstarts.py
- the prompt-quickstarts write/check targets (landing/prompts/catalog.yaml → catalog.generated.js)
- scripts/validate_visualization_images.py
- the CI example-validation and spellcheck jobs
